name: barefoot-css
description: Meet Barefoot CSS, the framework that kicked off its boots. No 200KB baggage, no Sass, no build step. Plain HTML styles itself from a handful of variables, and native elements do the work: dropdowns, dialogs, even tooltips, all accessible out of the box. The whole framework is 3.8KB gzipped. Your app should look like you, not us.

paragraphs: Kick off your boots. A bare-bones, themeable, JS-free CSS framework for people who'd rather not ship 200KB of stylesheet to render a button.
Live demos: conformance demo · layout playground · paint & paper · data story · form architecture · keyboard & a11y · resilience & coexistence · acceptance gate · theme studio
features: Tiny. Core (index.css) is 3KB gzipped. Import only what you use — no 200KB bundle.
Container-aware, not viewport-aware. Tables, forms, cards, and layouts adapt to the box they're in. No media queries, no JS. Try the playground.
Themeable in minutes. Every visual is a --bf- variable. No Sass, no rebuild. Tokens ship as W3C DTCG tokens.json.
JS-free by default. Dialogs are , accordions are , menus are popovers. Opt-in zero-dependency JS only where CSS can't reach (tabs, sorting, theme persistence).
Accessible. Native semantics, visible focus, AA contrast, forced-colors support, axe-core tested in CI.
